cases.exposure_context_quote: Patient information: an 18-year-old male patient, with no medical history, was brought to the emergency department (ED) by his family one hour after deliberate ingestion of 200 mL of pesticide containing indoxacarb in a suicide attempt.
cases.agent_quote: one hour after deliberate ingestion of 200 mL of pesticide containing indoxacarb in a suicide attempt
cases.circumstance: intentional ingestion (suicide attempt); brought to ED by family

symptoms.finding: drowsiness, GCS 13/15, bilateral mild-dilated reactive pupils
symptoms.quote: on arrival in the ED, he was drowsy, and he had a Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) of 13/15, with bilateral mild-dilated reactive pupils.
then the appearance of generalized fasciculations and muscle tremors.

symptoms.finding: severe central cyanosis with SpO2 80% despite FiO2 100%; muddy brown blood
symptoms.quote: he had remarkable central cyanosis and the SpO2 did not exceed 80% despite FiO2 of 100% contrasting with normal respiratory exam. The patient´s blood colour was abnormally muddy brown (Figure 1) associated with dark orange urine.
The conscious state was altered, and he became unresponsive with GCS of 8/15
In post-intubation, the patient presented a cardiovascular collapse (BP 80/40 mmHg and HR 120 b/m) requiring vasoactive drugs (0.5mg/h of norepinephrine)
One hour later, the patient vomited two times

labs.name: white blood cell count
labs.quote: laboratory analysis revealed: a white blood cell count of 23000/μL, hemoglobin: 13.6 g/dL, platelets: 273000/μL, alanine aminotransferase 45 IU/L, creatinine 48 μmol/L, sodium 137 mmol/L and potassium 4.26 mmol/L.

labs.name: methemoglobin
labs.value: 12.5% (reference <3%); fell to 1.3% 12 h after methylene blue
labs.quote: A blood sample was analyzed to determine the methemoglobin (MetHb) level, confirmed a level of 12.5% (reference range: <3%).

labs.name: ABG (on FiO2 100%)
labs.value: pH 7.47, PaO2 450 mmHg, PaCO2 24 mmHg, HCO3 17.3 mmol/L, SaO2 100% (SpO2 85%)
labs.quote: Arterial blood gas analysis (ABG) on FiO2 100% revealed pH 7.47, PaO2 450 mmHg, PaCO224 mmHg, HCO3 17.3 mmol/L, and arterial oxygen saturation (SaO2) 100%. The SpO2 was only 85%.

treatment.name: gastric lavage
treatment.quote: After monitoring, he received gastric lavage.

treatment.name: intubation and invasive mechanical ventilation (FiO2 100%)
treatment.quote: he was promptly intubated and put on assisted invasive mechanical ventilation with a fraction of inspired oxygen (FiO2) of 100%.

treatment.name: intravenous methylene blue 1.5 mg/kg (100 mg) in 100 mL normal saline over 30 minutes
treatment.quote: intravenous methylene blue was administered at a dosage of 1.5 mg/kg in 100 ml of normal saline for 30 minutes.

treatment.name: supportive and symptomatic management; weaning, extubation day 3, oxygen discontinued day 4
treatment.quote: the patient's respiratory and hemodynamic states were progressively improved, and he was weaned off vasopressor and mechanical ventilation. He was extubated on day three

cases.outcome: complete recovery; discharged day 4 without sequelae
cases.outcome_quote: On day four, he was discharged from the hospital with no sequelae.
cases.notes: First case of indoxacarb poisoning reported from Tunisia. Single dose of methylene blue sufficient. MetHb fell to 1.3% 12 h post-injection.
